positive: Shared seller-facing Telegram/Wickr/phone/IM/contact handle with support from cloned text, structural overlap, or coherent seller profile context.
Shared email only when clearly presented as seller contact and not as product/victim/sample account data.
Strong text-clone rows only when alias relation, migration wording, or seller-specific operational copy makes same-control evidence stronger than generic template reuse.
negative: Generic placeholders such as No Item Name / No Description Specified across unrelated sellers.
High semantic overlap caused by public product descriptions, medication boilerplate, software/book templates, leaked-data field formats, or inventory templates without identity closure.
Shared contact parser artifacts or product sample credentials, not seller identity.
uncertain: Strong content overlap without seller-specific identity closure.
Emails, URLs, account credentials, or phone-like tokens embedded in product/victim data.
Text clones that may be reseller/template reuse but cannot be confidently separated from same-controller reuse.
